newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SOCCER-FIFA SET DATE FOR RONALDO HEARING.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FIFA SET DATE FOR RONALDO HEARING.

text.p: Ronaldo's controversial transfer from Barcelona to Internazionale will be discussed by FIFA on July 22.
FIFA's Player's Status Committee will also examine an equally contentious move by French international defender Bixente Lizarazu from Athletic Bilbao to Bayern Munich.
At the centre of the disputes are the "buyout" or withdrawal clauses found in Spanish league contracts.

Ronaldo is reported to have bought out his contract with Barcelona for $27.5 million but the Spanish Football Federation has refused to issue a transfer certificate on the grounds that such "buyouts" are valid for domestic transfers only.
FIFA rules state that a player cannot buy out his contract for the purposes of obtaining an international move.
The dispute has been further complicated by a recent European Commission statement that FIFA transfer regulations may contravene European Union laws.
